text: …　…　たいちょうが　わるいから　しかた　ないわ

structure.jp: …　…　たいちょうが　わるいから

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a statement means 'because', giving the reason for what follows. たいちょうが　わるいから = 'because I'm not feeling well'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, feminine way to finish a sentence. しかた　ないわ = 'it can't be helped'.
